Clubs and Organizations

Students in the Lyles College of Engineering can become members of and participate in several clubs and organizations. The following are examples of some of the active student organizations.

The Lyles College of Engineering also has a student leadership council representing all LCOE student organizations below known as the Lyles College of Engineering Officers Council. Meetings are held monthly.

For more information or to join a club, please contact Mr. Hernan Maldonado, Director of Pathways at hernanm@csufresno.edu.
